task: Using the three supplied opaque BaO crystal candidates, independently determine the stable phase sequence between 0 and 80 GPa and estimate any crossover pressures. Then investigate whether an electronic-structure or bonding analysis can explain the observed structural preference, while distinguishing descriptive correlation from causal evidence.
scientific_mode_description: The scientific question and raw input boundary are fixed, but no paper method, software sequence, parameter protocol, candidate pathway, or stopping route is disclosed.
scientific_requirements: Choose and justify a pressure/volume sampling and refinement strategy with adaptive crossover refinement.
Use compatible periodic settings and normalize energies/enthalpies per BaO formula unit.
Validate structural identity after relaxation and do not silently compare collapsed phases.
Quantify convergence and interpolation uncertainty for every crossover claim.
Any orbital/bonding interpretation must be quality-gated and may not by itself prove energetic causation.

required_deliverables.description: Initial hypotheses, method alternatives, budgets, validation gates, stopping rules, and dated revisions.
One provenance record for every real chemistry-software invocation.
Claim-to-artifact map separating calculation, experiment, inference, and uncertainty.
Failed, rejected, retried, or inconclusive branches and their scientific consequence.
Structures, pressures/volumes, convergence, energies, volumes, and stresses.
Stable sequence, crossover estimates, interpolation uncertainty, and structural checks.
Chosen electronic/bonding descriptors, validation, alternatives, and causal limitations.
Final artifact-linked scientific report with limitations and unresolved uncertainty.

data.name: Autonomous multi-software research inputs
data.description: Three opaque BaO candidate crystal seeds and a 0-80 GPa investigation range; no volume grid, protocol, phase sequence, bonding basis, or transition pressure.
